_comment_purpose: Basic MCP server config template for Claude Desktop. Edit the Obsidian vault path, then merge this into ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS) or %AppData%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows). Prefer `enquire-mcp configure --tier basic --client claude-desktop --vault <path>` for generated output.
_comment_basic: basic — TF-IDF only, zero setup. Just point at the vault and go. Recall is fine for ~1k-note vaults; sub-200ms typical query latency.
_comment_hybrid: For the hybrid-live stack (BM25 + TF-IDF + ML embeddings + HNSW + reranker + PDFs/watch), see `claude-desktop-hybrid.json` next to this file.
